name: Aster USDF
oneLiner: USDF is Aster's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on BSC, minted 1:1 against USDT; yields from BTC/ETH funding-rate arbitrage via Ceffu MirrorX on Binance.
collateral: USDT held by custodian Ceffu; deployed in delta-neutral strategies (long spot + short perpetuals) executed via Ceffu MirrorX on Binance
pegMechanism: 1:1 USDT mint/redeem; yield from funding rate arbitrage via delta-neutral positions on Binance through Ceffu MirrorX

oracleRisk.summary: Aster manages USDF backing through custodial USDT and offchain delta-neutral positions, without publishing a user-CDP liquidation oracle or market-specific feed inventory.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified USDF token source exposes an ADMIN_ROLE-gated pause() function. Its paused transfer hook makes the contract-wide transfer path directly restrictable by the administrator, regardless of the separate inferred upstream exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: USDF uses AccessControl; MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE (0x144dc672...) is held by the USDFEarn UUPS proxy (0xc271fc70...) which mints USDF 1:1 on USDT deposit. The token's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and USDFEarn's immutable upgrade authority are the same 6-hour TimelockController. A 4-of-8 Safe is the timelock's sole external proposer, executor, and canceller, and separately holds USDFEarn's ADMIN_ROLE for direct changes to the 500 million USDF supply cap.

upgradeability.controlRef: USDF token admin and USDFEarn UUPS upgrade timelock

controls.label: USDFEarn contract (MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder)
controls.capDescription: USDFEarn enforces USDFMaxSupply = 500,000,000 USDF at the replay cutoff. The contract cannot change that cap itself; its separate ADMIN_ROLE holder can.
controls.evidence: At exact replay-cutoff BSC block 109812367, the USDF token recognized USDFEarn as a MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder. USDFEarn's EIP-1967 implementation was 0x9be60400d043864a99a8fe1be479c9eb299198c1, with zero admin and beacon slots, and USDFMaxSupply() was 500,000,000 USDF. The exact-match implementation source mints only after receiving USDT and enforces that cap. A complete post-cutoff log scan through block 109868579 found no Upgraded, role-change, or cap-change event, so the current authority state projects back to the cutoff.

controls.label: USDF token admin and USDFEarn UUPS upgrade timelock

routeChecks.signingModel: The sole external proposer, executor, and canceller is Safe 0xa8c0c6ee62f5ad95730fe23ccf37d1c1ffaa1c3f, threshold 4 of 8. The timelock also lists itself as proposer and executor so its wrappers can call the underlying controller, but it cannot originate an unscheduled operation.
routeChecks.rateLimits: getMinDelay() returned 21,600 seconds. The custom timelock's MAX_DELAY was 172,800 seconds, an execution-expiry window rather than an additional mandatory delay.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: USDFEarn's exact-match implementation restricts _authorizeUpgrade to the immutable TIMELOCK_ADDRESS. The same timelock is the USDF token's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and can grant or revoke MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE after the delay.

controls.evidence: At exact replay-cutoff BSC block 109812367 (hash 0x958afa5b82a24f0ee89387646d589882bf448dbb5fac8dce521b4911ae834202), USDFEarn's immutable TIMELOCK_ADDRESS resolved to this contract, whose getMinDelay() was 21,600 seconds. The timelock remained USDF's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder; the token's MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE is administered by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Timelock roles were self-admin plus Safe 0xa8c0...1c3f as the sole external proposer/executor and sole canceller. No upgrade, role, or delay change appeared in the complete post-cutoff scan through block 109868579.

controls.label: Astherus governance multisig (Timelock PROPOSER, 4/8 Safe)
controls.capDescription: This Safe directly holds USDFEarn's ADMIN_ROLE and can change the 500 million USDF maximum supply without the timelock. It separately governs delayed token-role and implementation changes through the timelock.
controls.evidence: At exact replay-cutoff BSC block 109812367, this Safe had 8 owners and threshold 4, with no enabled modules, guard, or fallback handler. It was the timelock's sole external proposer, executor, and canceller and the sole USDFEarn ADMIN_ROLE member. A complete post-cutoff scan through block 109868579 found no owner, threshold, module, guard, fallback-handler, or role changes.

review.evidence: At exact replay-cutoff BSC block 109812367 (2026-07-13T20:34:40Z; hash 0x958afa5b82a24f0ee89387646d589882bf448dbb5fac8dce521b4911ae834202), USDF remained a non-proxy token with USDFEarn 0xc271fc70... recognized as a MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder and timelock 0xe829a87f... recognized as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. USDFEarn was a UUPS proxy with implementation 0x9be60400..., zero admin/beacon slots, immutable upgrade authority equal to that timelock, and a 500 million USDF cap directly administered by Safe 0xa8c0c6ee.... The timelock delay was 21,600 seconds; its sole external proposer/executor/canceller was the same 4-of-8 Safe, with no module, guard, or fallback-handler bypass detected. Authority-sensitive logs across all affected contracts from block 109812368 through 109868579 contained no upgrade, role, delay, cap, owner, threshold, module, guard, or fallback-handler change.

reserves.name: USDT-funded spot crypto and corresponding short futures positions

reserveReview.rationale: Aster identifies crypto assets and corresponding short futures positions as the backing, with Ceffu custody, but does not disclose current spot, margin, or retained-USDT weights. The prior 50/25/25 split was unsupported and is replaced by one conservative reviewed basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Officially documented delta-neutral backing structure; constituent shares are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Aster does not publish current weights for retained USDT, spot BTC/ETH, or futures-margin exposure.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: USDT funds the strategy, but no current constituent weights support treating a portion of the aggregate basket as direct USDT collateral.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Aster documents Ceffu custody with MirrorX off-exchange settlement onto Binance, under which assets remain with the custodian while balances are mirrored to the exchange for the delta-neutral strategy. Account-level segregation, insolvency treatment, and the exact scope of assets deployed as futures margin are not established by the reviewed sources.

dependencyReview.rationale: USDF is minted from and redeemed to USDT at the protocol's 1:1 reference. USDT therefore supplies both the holder exit asset and the reference unit, while USDF's actively managed backing and local controls remain distinct rather than inheriting USDT as a mechanically identical wrapper claim.

relationships.reason: USDT is the protocol's 1:1 redemption output for USDF.
USDT is the protocol's 1:1 reference unit for USDF mint and redemption accounting.
